records.text: People with direct knowledge said a succession question was asked at the Aspen event, but Charlie Kirk only answered that he trusted his Turning Point USA lieutenants to handle matters in his absence.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep 1QZ4X6q1DPg)

appearances.snippet: We broke the story that that video is likely not authentic. People with direct knowledge tell me that, yes, certainly a question was asked, but the answer which Charlie (Charlie Kirk) gave was simply that he trusted his lieutenants at the company to figure things out in the event of his absence. His mind just was not there.

verification.notes: The anonymous account reported in the transcript says Charlie Kirk only referred to trusted lieutenants and did not appoint Erika. The later-released clip directly shows him saying he appointed his wife to run Turning Point USA if something happened to him, and Daily Mail reporters state they screened the full Aspen footage and heard that sentence. This directly contradicts the anonymous account. Confidence is medium because public AI-manipulation allegations have not been resolved by independent forensic authentication.
